name: Case law: United States, the Wisconsin Supreme Court
label: United States case law (the Wisconsin Supreme Court)
coverage: 39849 published decisions, one file each, dated the day decided: 38965 with their opinion text and 884 with CAP head matter only (CAP holds no opinion text for them); 78 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day. Read from Wis., Wis. 2d, N.W.2d, Pin., Chand., Bur., Colo. L. Rep.. The head matter (syllabi, headnotes, counsel) is left out: it is the publisher's text, not the court's. Every decision is a published opinion (precedential_status: published); CAP records no other status. CAP is a closed archive (its last volumes are of 2018-2020): no nightly runner appends to this repo. The US Code record holds only some titles, so most statute citations are not linked.
update: none: the Caselaw Access Project is a static archive, so no nightly runner is registered

source.publisher: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard Law School Library)
source.reporters: Wis., Wis. 2d, N.W.2d, Pin., Chand., Bur., Colo. L. Rep.

overlay.reader: tools/usc_cite.py: a page stamp ("USCA4") is no citation, "(a)(4)" a subsection, "§§ 1-16" a range read at its two ends; a citation under an older numbering (before the title was recodified, before the section was added, an earlier edition, "former") is not linked; one row per decision (decision-relations.tsv duplicates left out)

relations.same-decision-as: the file is the same decision as the target (same day, docket or name, and text); both are kept
relations.moved-to: the decision was routed here by mistake and is now at the target (<repo>/<path>); this file was removed

decision_dates.note: decisions whose CAP date gives only the month or the year (precision month or year): committed on the first day of it, In-force likewise
